recentItems.title: Mike Leigh on Bleak Moments | BFI Q&A
recentItems.description:
Mike Leigh visits BFI Southbank to discuss Bleak Moments. His debut film, it's a tender, unsparing study of isolation and human connection.

Mike Leigh’s understated feature debut, about a woman caring for her sister, is a devastating portrait of loneliness, routine and the fragile search for connection. With extraordinary sensitivity and a keen eye for everyday life, Leigh’s compassion, observation and emotional sensitivity transform the ordinary into something deeply affecting.

recentItems.description:
